patch.value: Post-apply close conflict retains applied transaction markers

Greptile exact-head review of PR 73 found that treating every nonzero close receipt as an unverified failure preserves markers even when the close mutation actually persisted and the item is terminal. The next import then mistakes the compensated row for an applied row and skips recreating it. Re-read status after a nonzero close receipt: clean markers only with exact closed evidence, otherwise retain them for reconciliation.

A red real-tracker race regression persists close but returns exit 4 and proves old code retains markers; Compensation rechecks status after every nonzero close receipt; Exact closed evidence permits marker cleanup; Open or unknown status preserves both markers; Status lookup failure remains best-effort and never aborts the compensation sweep; npm run release:check passes exact 100/100/100/100

Create a marked open item; make the pm close wrapper persist the close but return exit 4; run compensateCreate; inspect status and transaction markers; retry would otherwise skip the closed tombstone.
After any nonzero close receipt, an exact closed status recheck permits marker cleanup; open or unknown status preserves both markers; no receipt alone is treated as closure evidence.
The item became closed but compensateCreate returned on exit 4 without a status recheck, retaining csv-txrow and causing resume to treat the compensated tombstone as applied.

message: Track Greptile post-apply close conflict finding

patch.value: The post-apply exit-4 race now rechecks as closed and removes both markers, while the existing exit-4-with-open-state regression retains both markers. Status read overruns remain non-throwing in the compensation sweep.

After any nonzero compensation close receipt, re-read the item status through the best-effort status seam. Remove transaction markers only when that recheck proves closed; retain markers and surface the close failure for open, absent, or unverified results.
